answer: A fresh agent starts low on the knoll of trust, near zero weight, and climbs only as independent peers attest to honest work across many epochs. Each identity posts a refundable stake-bond that unlocks slowly, so a clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake; sybil cost scales linearly, never a cheap ledge to vault onto. Genuine standing accrues over time and is as hard to forge as a carved opal.
